caption: Spicy, deep red, glossy broth with oil sheen and floating ingredients swirls around thick noodles. Chashu pork with caramelized brown exterior and marbling sits in a white ceramic bowl with red rim, green dragon pattern, and red Chinese characters, on a smooth, vibrant orange table.

segments_info.text: The table is a smooth, vibrant orange surface with subtle light reflections and faint texture variations.
Chashu pork slice shows caramelized brown exterior, tender white interior, and visible fat marbling with slight sheen.
The spicy broth is deep red, glossy, and thick, swirling around noodles and toppings with visible oil sheen and floating ingredients.
White ceramic bowl with red rim, green dragon pattern, and red Chinese characters around its edge.
